method: GitHub REST API metadata (repos/{owner}/{repo}, /license, /commits/HEAD) and gh search, read-only. No source code was copied, vendored, or installed. SHA is the default-branch HEAD at query time.

repos.name: yt-dlp
repos.reason: Permissive, but its use case is downloading media from platforms, which sits against our official-API rule and platform ToS. Use only for manual research on public files if ever needed.

repos.name: instaloader
repos.reason: MIT, but it uses Instagram's unofficial private API. High account-suspension risk and against ToS. Reuse the idea of our own saves ingestion only through the stash vault.

repos.name: praw
repos.reason: Clean license and maintained. Only needed if Reddit read-only research is wanted; the existing gather.py already reads Reddit over plain HTTP with app-only auth, so praw is not required. Reading only, no automated posting.

repos.name: snscrape (JustAnotherArchivist fork, found via gh search)
repos.reason: GPL-3.0 copyleft, scraping-based, and not reliably maintained. Not worth the license or ToS risk. The original owner path JustinCSmith/snscrape returned 404.

repos.name: n8n
repos.decision: do-not-embed; evaluate as service only if needed
repos.reason: Source-available 'Other' license, not OSI open source. Use as a hosted or self-hosted tool under its terms, never embed code. Approval-loop templates are useful as reference only. Our current engine does not need it.

repos.name: promptfoo
repos.reason: MIT and active. Good fit for regression-testing hook and script prompt quality as a dev tool. Keep out of the runtime. Adopt only if the existing pytest + validate gates prove insufficient.

repos.name: deepeval
repos.reason: Apache-2.0 and active. Pytest-style LLM evals. Overlaps promptfoo; pick one, not both. Adds a dependency tree, so only if we need metric-based grading.

repos.name: Baserow
repos.reason: Mixed/'Other' license (MIT core with premium parts under separate terms, per GitHub's NOASSERTION). Only consider as a hosted content-calendar database if a spreadsheet stops working. Not needed for the engine.

repos.name: Postiz
repos.reason: AGPL-3.0 network copyleft. Do not copy code or host it inside our product. Matches existing repos.md decision: reuse the approval/scheduling separation idea only.

repos.name: short-video-maker
repos.reason: MIT but stale (last push June 2025). Its Remotion + Kokoro + caption pipeline matches what we already run. Keep the staged script/audio/render separation as a checklist. Consistent with repos.md.

repos.name: hook generator (Peter365-star/short-video-hook-generator)
repos.reason: No license (all rights reserved by default), 0 stars, no evidence of quality. Read as an idea reference only; do not copy prompts or code.

repos.name: script generation search (gh search 'reels script generator llm')
repos.reason: Search returned zero repositories. Nothing to evaluate.

repos.name: Instagram caption generator (singhsourav0/Instagram-captions-generator)
repos.reason: MIT but tiny (4 stars) and stale. Other caption-generator hits were unlicensed. Our captions come from the existing prompt pipeline.

gaps: SHAs for snscrape, short-video-maker, and the hook/caption repos were not captured; their URLs and metadata came from gh search only.
LICENSE text was not read in full; SPDX comes from the GitHub license API, which is what is recorded here. Re-check before any copy.
NOASSERTION on n8n and Baserow means GitHub could not classify the license; the decision is based on the LICENSE file names and the project's own stated model.
